keyVerseDR: "Let every man be swift to hear, but slow to speak." (Jas 1:19)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Open-Mindedness
level1.story: Open-mindedness means looking at things from every fair side before deciding. We listen first, then we choose.
level1.keyLine: I listen first, then I decide.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice open-mindedness all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: When did we listen before deciding this week?
Did anyone change their mind after learning something new?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Holy Spirit, open my ears and my mind. Help me listen and think fairly. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Listen to a friend's idea all the way through
TUE: Try a food you think you won't like
WED: Play a game your sibling chooses
THU: Ask, 'What do you think?' to someone
FRI: Say 'Maybe you're right' once today
SAT: Pray before making a choice

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Open-Mindedness
level2.story: Open-mindedness means thinking about a situation from every fair side before we make up our minds. We do not jump to conclusions. We listen to other people, look at the facts, and are willing to change our minds when we learn something true. Saint James says to be quick to hear and slow to speak. An open mind still holds tight to God's truth, while listening with love.
level2.keyLine: I listen first, then I decide.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice open-mindedness all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: When did we listen before deciding this week?
How did God help us grow in open-mindedness?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Holy Spirit, open my ears and my mind. Help me listen and think fairly. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Hear both sides before settling an argument
TUE: Ask someone why they think differently
WED: Change your mind when you learn something true
THU: Read about a saint very different from you
FRI: Look for facts before judging a story
SAT: Ask the Holy Spirit to help you think fairly
